# One state, every surface: a form, a dialog and a second window

## Context

State & Data shows one card on `dev` `78013b10fc`: "State Provider Example" (`examples/stateProvider/advanced`, record `state-provider`). #21140's target renews it as "One state, every surface", and the band's epic #21358 counts it among its nine renewals. The folder's only change since the slate is the theme switcher of 21 Nov. No leaf was filed.

## The Problem

The band's read ([its rows](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980292611)): "Fields named `data.button1Text` in the top third of a dark page; two of its five buttons only log to the console. The bindings work." Eight more `stateProvider/` folders each show one binding on an empty page. A visitor who asks "where does state live, and how does it reach a component, a dialog and another window?" gets an API sample, not an answer.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/state/Provider.mjs`: hierarchical state providers; a nested provider can override a value of its parent.
- `examples/stateProvider/advanced`: the folder to rebuild in place. `examples/stateProvider/multiWindow` already binds one provider across two windows (its record `multi-window-state-provider` has no cover).
- Providers stay at view roots, and a data view binds a store of records, not a hand-mapped array.

## The Fix

Rebuild the example as a profile or settings screen with real content. A header follows a form as the visitor types. A nested provider overrides one value for one panel, and the page says so. The same record opens in a dialog and in a second window, and an edit in any of them shows in all. One line on the first frame says what to try. The record keeps its place in State & Data and gets `alsoIn: ['multi-window']`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An edit in the form shows in the header, in the open dialog and in the second window, without a reload.
- [ ] One panel shows a value overridden by a nested provider, named on the page.
- [ ] Every button's effect is visible on the page; nothing logs to the console as its only result.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844 (where the second window is offered only if a popup can open), in every theme the example offers.
- [ ] The record's name and caption are in the visitor's words, and its cover is retaken from the new first frame (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame and the frame with dialog and second window open, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

The other eight `stateProvider/` folders (they stay as folders without a record). A change to `src/state/Provider.mjs`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Nine cards for one concept.** The target retires seven samples from the catalog for a reason: one screen that answers the question beats eight that each show a binding.
